      close(fd); // closes the socket 



// below frees the linked lists associated w/ addrinfo (ie closes things out) 
// [https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/freeaddrinfo.html#:~:text=The%20freeaddrinfo()%20function%20frees%20one%20or%20more,freeing%20arbitrary%20sublists%20of%20an%20addrinfo%20list.]
      freeaddrinfo(pai); // frees the socket 
      return 0LL;
    }
  }
  else
  {
    freeaddrinfo(pai); // closes things out
    return 0xFFFFFFFFLL;
  }
}
